## Connectors type

The connectors a loader reads through, and when it may run: `allOf` when every one is readable  (a query that joins two stores), `oneOf` when one is (replicas, mirrors: the load reads the  readable ones).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Connectors<C extends string> = 
/** available only when every one is readable */
{
    readonly allOf: readonly [C, ...C[]];
}
/** available when one is readable */
 | {
    readonly oneOf: readonly [C, ...C[]];
};
```
